blocks.text: Buying a 55+ Age-Restricted Townhome in Pitt Meadows, BC

parts.t: Pitt Meadows is one of the most practical downsizing communities in the Lower Mainland thanks to its completely flat topography, walkable town centre, and quiet residential cul-de-sacs. Well-known 55+ townhome communities such as Twin Oaks (19250 119 Ave, built 1993) offer single-level rancher and master-on-main layouts with attached garages and private patios.

Under British Columbia's Strata Property Act (Bill 44), 55+ age-restriction bylaws remain fully enforceable, preserving quiet adult-oriented communities within walking distance of the Pitt Meadows Senior Activity Centre (19065 119B Ave), Meadowvale Shopping Centre, medical clinics, and the West Coast Express.

blocks.text: What to Check When Buying a 55+ Townhome in Pitt Meadows

parts.t: Because Pitt Meadows has a small number of 55+ townhome complexes, listings sell quickly when they hit the MLS®. Before removing conditions, we review the Form B Information Certificate, two years of strata council and AGM minutes, the Depreciation Report (checking roof, skylight, siding, and paving dates), pet and RV parking bylaws, and crawlspace/slab moisture inspection reports.

blocks.text: Frequently Asked Questions About Pitt Meadows 55+ Senior Townhomes for Sale

parts.t: Where are 55+ townhomes located in Pitt Meadows?

Are 55+ age restrictions still enforceable in Pitt Meadows townhomes?
Yes. Under British Columbia's Strata Property Act amendments (Bill 44), 55+ age-restriction bylaws remain 100% legal and enforceable across BC.
Where is the Pitt Meadows Senior Activity Centre?

The Pitt Meadows Senior Activity Centre (operated by the Ridge Meadows Seniors Society) is located at 19065 119B Avenue in Central Meadows, right next to the Pitt Meadows Family Recreation Centre and Spirit Square.
Do Pitt Meadows 55+ townhomes have single-level rancher floor plans?

Yes. Many units in Pitt Meadows 55+ townhome communities are true single-level ranchers (zero interior stairs) or 1.5-storey master-on-main homes with main-floor laundry, radiant or forced-air heat, and an attached garage.
How often do 55+ townhomes come up for sale in Pitt Meadows?

Because Pitt Meadows is a compact municipality with only a handful of 55+ townhome complexes, active listings are limited and often sell quickly; setting up an instant MLS® alert ensures you see new listings on day one.
Can I defer my annual property taxes on a 55+ townhome in Pitt Meadows?
Yes. Qualifying BC homeowners aged 55 or older can apply to the provincial Property Tax Deferment Program to defer annual City of Pitt Meadows property taxes on their principal residence.
